summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its routine open-market buyback of treasury shares for the week of August 10–14, 2026, under a program approved May 6, 2026. It acquired 3,157,831 shares (0.10% of capital) at an average price of €23.7505, total consideration ~€75.0 million. Since May 8, cumulative purchases reached 56,681,311 shares (1.87%) for ~€1.265 billion, with holdings at 4.74%. This is a routine capital return disclosure, not a special situation; it is an issuer buyback under an ongoing program, not a tender or strategic transaction.
